top_choice_rationale: P003 credits a complete chain from concept to discovery: the Kane-Mele quantum spin Hall effect and Z2 invariant, and Molenkamp's HgTe edge-transport experiment, confirmed for nearly two decades with a stable interpretation (bulk-boundary correspondence) and a citation confined to the two-dimensional case. P001 is scientifically strong and cleanly allocated but about eight years old with an open pairing mechanism and Andrei excluded; P002 is mature and cleanly attributed but a refinement of the metrology honoured in 2005 and 2012. A prize in this slate is preferable to no award.
